author: Yffe
content: Build 1d-i: extend the contract-sublanguage T1 proof (the #170/#176/#177/#178 fragment) to the 6 bounded-quantifier combinators (forall_in/exists_in/sorted/forall_below/forall_from/disjoint). Ast.lean += CombName + mutual Pred + Expr.comb (args per CombinatorSig.arg_kinds); Denote.lean += Env.bindInt + denote comb arm (frozen verus_l3 quantifier forms, matched EXACTLY to combinators.rs); RefEncode.lean += refDenote comb arm (same form, args threaded per arg-kind: Slice->@-view, Index->SCALAR int #145, Pred->flat closure body); Soundness.lean += ref_sound/refVal_eq comb case + negatives wrong_combinator_breaks_soundness and index_argkind_slice_view_breaks_soundness (#145). Core Lean only; the 2 recursive combinators remain #182, absent (no sorry). lake build green, axioms [propext, Quot.sound], Rust unaffected.
